title: 第十七章 相亲蒋南孙第十八章 余青青
content_zh:
第二天，咖啡厅。
姜辰刚走进咖啡厅就看到了坐在窗口的蒋南孙，当下微笑着走了过去。
“是你啊！”
姜辰笑容满面的看着蒋南孙说道：“没想到我们竟然在这里见面。”
“我们见过？”
蒋南孙目光看向姜辰，眉头一皱。
蒋鹏飞安排她相亲也不是一次两次啦，但因为是她的父亲，她都没办法拒绝，这次也一样。
只是她不记得姜辰和她见过。
“两个月前，我在魔都大学见过你，当初还向你问图书馆在什么地方。”姜辰回答道。
“原来是你。”蒋南孙想起来了。
“没想到这么巧。”
姜辰在蒋南孙面前坐下，然后向服务员要了一杯拿铁。
“我叫姜辰，很高兴认识你。”姜辰自我介绍道。
“蒋南孙。”
蒋南孙的脸色冷淡：“姜先生，虽然我来和你相亲，但我和你是不可能的。”
“你有男朋友了？”姜辰问道。
“是。”蒋南孙的脑海中闪过了一道身影，虽然没有确认男女朋友的关系，但在她看来，他就是她的男朋友。
“不可能吧？”
姜辰也想到了章安仁，心中有些暗恼，不过却没有表现出来：“如果你有男朋友的话，蒋叔怎么没有告诉我？难道蒋叔骗我？”
“我没有告诉我父亲。”蒋南孙说道。

“是吗？”
姜辰看着蒋南孙，说道：“这不会就是你拒绝我的借口吧？”
“你可以这么理解。”蒋南孙道。
“其实我也不想和你相亲的。”姜辰说道。
“那我告辞了。“蒋南孙站了起来。
“等一下。”姜辰叫道。
蒋南孙看向姜辰。
“如果我没猜错的话，蒋叔让你相亲不是一次两次了吧？而你有男朋友，蒋叔却让你相亲，只有两个原因。第一，就是你没有将自己有男朋友的事告诉蒋叔。第二，就是蒋叔对你的男朋友不满。”
姜辰淡淡的说道：“而我可以解决你不去相亲的日子。”
“什么意思？”蒋南孙问道。
“从你刚才的表现来看，蒋叔让你相亲已经让你不厌其烦了。只要你假装和我相亲成功了，蒋叔就不会让你继续去相亲了，等你带男朋友回家的时候，我们就告诉蒋叔已经和平分手了。”姜辰其实也知道通过蒋鹏飞的介绍，想要让蒋南孙成为女朋友是不可能的。
但他也不想就这么的让蒋南孙离开。
现在如果让蒋南孙离开的话，他是没有希望让蒋南孙成为自己的女朋友的。
所以，最好的办法就是找个借口保持和蒋南孙的联系。
“你为什么这么做？”蒋南孙问道。
“和你一样。”姜辰说道。
“什么意思？”
“怕相亲。”姜辰说道：“今年我已经第十次相亲了。我不想将时间浪费在这上面。”
当然，姜辰可没有去相亲，蒋南孙也调查不到他，等蒋南孙什么时候知道了，这已经无关紧要了。
从目前的情况来看，蒋南孙还没有带章安仁去见蒋鹏飞，至少说明剧情还没开始。

“就这？”蒋南孙显然不信。
“我们加个微信，如果你同意了，可以通知我，如果不同意，回去之后将我拉黑名单就行。”姜辰说道。
content_en:
The next day, coffee shop.
As soon as Jiang Chen walked into the coffee shop, he saw Jiang Nansun sitting at the window and walked over with a smile.
"It's you!"
Jiang Chen looked at Jiang Nansun with a smile on his face and said, "I didn't expect us to meet here."
"Have we met?"
Jiang Nansun looked at Jiang Chen and frowned.
Jiang Pengfei arranged blind dates for her more than once or twice, but because he was her father, she couldn't refuse, and it was the same this time.
It’s just that she doesn’t remember Jiang Chen meeting her.
"Two months ago, I met you at Modu University, and I asked you where the library was." Jiang Chen replied.
"It turned out to be you." Jiang Nansun remembered.
"I didn't expect such a coincidence."
Jiang Chen sat down in front of Jiang Nansun, and then asked the waiter for a latte.
"My name is Jiang Chen, nice to meet you." Jiang Chen introduced himself.
"Jiang Nansun."
Jiang Nansun's face was cold: "Mr. Jiang, although I have come to have a blind date with you, it is impossible for you and me to go on a blind date."
"Do you have a boyfriend?" Jiang Chen asked.
"Yes." A figure flashed in Jiang Nansun's mind. Although the relationship between boyfriend and girlfriend was not confirmed, in her opinion, he was her boyfriend.
"Isn't it possible?"
Jiang Chen also thought of Zhang Anren, and was a little annoyed in his heart, but he didn't show it: "If you have a boyfriend, why didn't Uncle Jiang tell me? Could it be that Uncle Jiang lied to me?"
"I didn't tell my father." Jiang Nansun said.
"Really?"
Jiang Chen looked at Jiang Nansun and said, "Isn't this your excuse for rejecting me?"
"You can understand it that way." Jiang Nansun said.
"Actually, I don't want to go on a blind date with you." Jiang Chen said.
"Then I'll take my leave." Jiang Nansun stood up.
"Wait a minute." Jiang Chen called.
Jiang Nansun looked at Jiang Chen.
"If I'm not wrong, Uncle Jiang asked you to go on a blind date once or twice, right? And you have a boyfriend, but Uncle Jiang asked you to go on a blind date. There are only two reasons. The first is that you didn't tell Uncle Jiang that you have a boyfriend. The second is that Uncle Jiang is dissatisfied with your boyfriend."
Jiang Chen said calmly: "And I can solve the problem of you not going on a blind date."
"What do you mean?" Jiang Nansun asked.
"Judging from your performance just now, Uncle Jiang has asked you to go on a blind date. As long as you pretend to be on a blind date with me, Uncle Jiang will not let you continue to go on blind dates. When you bring your boyfriend home, we will tell Uncle Jiang that we have broken up peacefully." Jiang Chen actually knew that it was impossible to make Jiang Nansun his girlfriend through Jiang Pengfei's introduction.
But he didn't want to let Jiang Nansun leave just like that.
If he lets Jiang Nansun leave now, he has no hope of letting Jiang Nansun become his girlfriend.
Therefore, the best way is to find an excuse to keep in touch with Jiang Nansun.
"Why did you do this?" Jiang Nansun asked.
"Same as you." Jiang Chen said.
"What do you mean?"
"Afraid of blind dates." Jiang Chen said, "This is my tenth blind date this year. I don't want to waste my time on it."
Of course, Jiang Chen didn't go on a blind date, and Jiang Nansun couldn't investigate him. When Jiang Nansun found out, it wouldn't matter anymore.
Judging from the current situation, Jiang Nansun has not brought Zhang Anren to meet Jiang Pengfei, which at least means that the plot has not begun yet.
"That's it?" Jiang Nansun obviously didn't believe it.
"Let's add a WeChat account. If you agree, you can notify me. If you don't agree, just blacklist me when you get back." Jiang Chen said.
